info.title: MCR private observability/readback contract
info.description: Contract-only readback HTTP binding; no route registered. In-process tenant-scoped store readback is implemented. No provider effects or public metrics.

get.description: Tenant scope derives only from verified principal. Reject absent/mismatched tenant scope. Unknown or stale evidence remains not ready. No arbitrary tenant query parameter.

200.description: Fail-closed projection evidence; ready may be false

monitoringBearer.description: Require monitoring-readonly identity and mcr.delivery.read scope plus a verified tenant binding on private ingress.
